# Known, pending and deferred names describe separate new-mail states

The current MessageTracker uses _knownNewMessages for deduplication, _pendingNewMessages for queued headers and _deferredNewMessagesNotifications for scheduled delivery. addPendingNewMessage and emitPendingNewMessages name the two transitions. Scoped naming recommendation in this code: name collections and methods after their distinct state and action instead of one generic messages list. Their key types still need source or type documentation; the names alone do not guarantee folder-scoped identity. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: MessageTracker state naming.
